raw_recipe.headline: Krystal’s Perfect Marinade for BBQ or Grilled Chicken
raw_recipe.description: This BBQ chicken marinade made with balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire, sesame oil, and garlic adds wonderful flavor to any cut of chicken.
raw_recipe.name: Krystal’s Perfect Marinade for BBQ or Grilled Chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Whisk brown sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, olive oil, Worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and pepper together in a large bowl until sugar has dissolved.

review.reviewBody: Very nice marinade for chicken! I left out the sesame oil, used low sodium soy sauce and cut the black pepper down to 1/4 tsp. In order to give this a sort of sweet and smoky flavor I added 1 tsp. of liquid smoke. I let this marinate all day. The brown sugar carmelized the chicken on the grill and the result was very nice in both color and flavor. It went great with rice and veggies!

My husband said, 'this is the only way we make bbq chicken from now on'. I use low sodium soy sauce and that is my only change. It gives a lot of flavor to the chicken and we use it on all cuts, skinless and boneless.

THE best marinade ever, just as is! Sometimes I increase garlic or add ginger. I also reduce sesame oil, slightly. I marinade 24 hrs or longer, with great results. But I am sure that a shorter time would be fine too. Sometimes I use boneless/skinless thighs and breasts and shorten cooking time. Everybody in my world loves this recipe! Give it a try!

This was really good. Didn't have a lot of chicken, so took half the marinade and simmered it down to thicken a bit, then added sautéed mushrooms and green onions to it and served it as a sauce with the chicken. Great flavor combination, will be making this again.

10 out of 10!!!! Used this marinade last night on bbq’d chicken. The only thing I changed was I used garlic powder instead of fresh garlic for a milder, not as pungent garlic taste. Family LOVED it. I sliced chicken breasts lengthwise in half (cutlets) for faster more even grilling. I marinated cutlets in a freezer bag for about 3 hours. Drained marinade and put in pre-heated med-high gas grill. Chicken looked so good on bbq- beautiful grill marks, heavenly smell. I thought I might need some extra marinade for basting but you don’t. It caramelized perfectly. Just had it last night and can’t wait to have it again. It’s that good folks.

I like marinades you can actually taste in the finished product. This is one of my favorites. Tangy sweet salty but mild enough you know it’s chicken underneath. I added fresh grated ginger and 1/2 lime juice. Gave it a lil’ zip… easy and delicious.

This was very quick, easy, and absolutely delicious. I eyeballed the measurements, added some onion powder, and used honey instead of brown sugar. I let the chicken marinate for 24 hours, and i couldn't have asked for better results. I'll definitely make this again.

Awesome stuff I use it for chicken, jerky and pork. It is the best for marinating a turkey breast overnight then on the BBQ. I recommend you marinade your meat longer than just two hours. If you don't have the time, follow the recipe and then put marinade in pot and bring to boil lower heat and reduce 10 mins. Great glaze.

I didn't have enough balsamic vinegar - about 3/4 of the 1/2 cup required - so I added a balsamic vinegar dressing to meet the requirement... I really liked it with chicken legs, which I marinated for like 20 hours straight... My guess is that this marinade would be a killing with chicken wings.... :)
Added some chili garlic sauce to the marinade (the type with the Sri Ra Cha rooster on the front). So good!

This is outstanding. I could drink this straight. Because balsamic can be expensive, I also tried it with apple cider vinegar, and that was a winner, too. I like the sesame oil, but if you don't want as much of a strong Asian flavor, I agree with others that you could leave it out. Time to go and get this marinade on the chicken before I drink it all!
I made it exactly by the recipe and it was great. Now I’m going to try it with hamburger patties.

Yummy!!!!! This has become my go-to recipe for bbq chicken. The flavor is outstanding! We love to use the chicken legs or drumsticks. Every so often I add a good shake of smoked spanish paprika for a little spice.
Soaked legs overnight, and grilled them on the Traeger grill. They were very good, and juicy! I'll make this again!
Loved this recipe. Didnt have the seseme oil but it was this was so good on the BBQ.
followed it exactly and it was wonderful! will definitely be using this recipe again, thank you :)

Loved this! Saved our Thanksgiving because we had this grilled chicken which made up for overcooked, dried up turkey breast. Leftovers made some awesome quesadillas with creamy Oaxaca cheese. Son proclaimed them the best quesadillas he had ever had. Next time I make this I might leave out the sesame oil. Thank you for this great recipe!
AWESOME marinade for chicken! Made this last night and the chicken was so tender and tasty
